theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Starting Small, Building Big Habits
body: Beginning with ₹500 monthly teaches discipline, leverages time, and builds wealth through consistent investing habits.
caption: Every rupee invested today works harder tomorrow. Starting early means more time for your money to grow through consistent contributions. Small amounts, big discipline, lasting wealth. #YoungInvestor #ConsistentInvesting #WealthBuilding #StartSmall #MoneyMatters
